relationships.subject: GABAAergic disinhibition

key_findings: Lamina IIi PKCγ+ interneurons in adult rat medullary dorsal horn receive almost exclusively GABAAR-only or GlyR-only quantal IPSCs, although ~80% of their inhibitory synapses contain both GABAARα2 and GlyRα1.

Nearly all inhibitory boutons on PKCγ+ interneurons are GAD+ (GABAergic) and about half also contain GlyT2, suggesting GABA/glycine co-release with pharmacological rather than anatomical specialization.
